# Baseline results (tuning season)

*Generated by `pipeline/04_baseline.R` on 2026-10-07. Trained on 2023-2024, scored on 2025. The 2026 test season is held back until Phase 3.*

## What the baseline is

For every pitch, predict the pitcher's overall pitch mix from earlier seasons, ignoring count, batter and situation. Each pitcher's mix is pulled toward the league mix for pitchers with the same throwing hand and role (starter or reliever), and the pull is stronger the less history he has.

## Headline

| baseline | pitches | log_loss | top1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| League mix for his hand and role (no pitcher info) | 707,559 | 1.883 | 32.0% |
| His own past mix, almost no shrinkage (kappa = 1) | 707,559 | 1.664 | 39.2% |
| His own past mix, shrunk (tuned) | 707,559 | 1.561 | 39.1% |

*Log loss: lower is better; it heavily punishes confident wrong answers. Top-1: how often the single most likely pitch was the one thrown.*

Chosen settings: **kappa = 100** (each pitcher starts with 100 pitches' worth of league mix) and **decay = 0.25** (the season two years back counts 0.25 as much as last season).
